note: Greenland's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the tax number of every natural person is the CPR number, a Danish system issued under the Civil Registration System Act by the Central Registration Office; all residents of Greenland or Denmark get one. So Greenland's people hold Denmark's number.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Greenland: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: In Greenland the TIN equals the CPR number for all natural persons ... The CPR number is a Danish system and is issued after the rules in the Civil Registration ... All residents in Greenland or Denmark gets a CPR number
